items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: You remember what Marcus Garvey used to look like, huh?

ctx.x: No, no. They're different. I mean, yeah. No, no. He'd be different. Always different. Grand Marshal's always different. Would he dress more formally than the members, or not? No, he'd be more outstanding than the members, yeah. What kind of... I mean, if, say, the members had those black and white striped shirts on... Shirts, yeah. What... Well, he would have that, but he'd have a big streamer. Uh-huh. You see, from this way, see? And he'd recognize that he was a Marshal. He's a Grand Marshal, see?
Would... You remember what Marcus Garvey used to look like, huh? You remember they deported him? Yeah. You remember the uniforms he had? Yeah.
